name: Drywall sheet count
summary: Sheet count from wall/ceiling area, one sheet's area, and waste.
author: friday-core
description: sheets = ceil(area / sheetArea × (1+waste)). Default sheet area 2.88 m² (1.2×2.4). This is a planning aid, not a substitute for a licensed engineer's calculations or sign-off, and it is not professional certification.
